notes: Closure method: (a) static fixpoint scan — every path-like literal in all 21 captured text files resolved against the manifest at capture-root-relative, ./relative and assets/-prefixed bases (unresolved: dynamic fragments, credits text, source-take names — recorded below); (b) opencli browser network logs from two live sessions (previous agent's 290-request log + this session's 76 entries) cross-checked against the manifest — 100% of same-origin responses were captured files, zero uncaptured 200s; (c) systematic twin sweep over every captured path (base/.lq.webp twins, .bin/.glb source twins) probed live.

Closure gaps found and fixed 2026-10-13 (previous crawl incomplete): 14 existing-but-uncaptured .lq.webp texture variants (assets/tex/*_lo.lq.webp, lm/fortmason/*, lm/pier39/*) — fetched and added; plus the served root routes /robots.txt (200, 1,248 B) and /index.html (the feed shell's /index.html-flavoured twin, 51,907 B, captured as shell-index.html). Capture grew 394 -> 410 files.

Genuine upstream 404s (recorded, not captured): the un-gzipped .bin/.glb source twins of every dist .gz (the origin serves only the .gz), and the .lq.webp variants of assets that never had them (turntables, car _2k maps, waymo maps, titles, icons). List in unreachable.
Audio closure is exact: assets/audio/audio.json names 146 files, all 146 captured, and every captured audio file is named in it.
The 9 un-gzipped /assets/real/*.bin and /assets/real/{marin,west}/*.bin probes 404 upstream (dist ships .gz only).

Boot test: mirror served on loopback (directory-index-capable), game reached actual gameplay (Waymo driving in San Francisco, HUD live), docs/cover.png + docs/boot-evidence.png captured from gameplay, listener killed, port proven closed.

Drift probe tools/update.mjs: up to date — 410 captured files identical upstream (routes: /?mb=game -> index.html byte-exact; / -> shell.html byte-exact; /index.html -> shell-index.html byte-exact; every asset byte-exact).
Refresh 2026-10-30: trust gate passed (384/410 still-served files byte-exact), 25 replaced (originals in legacy/2026-10-30/), 1 upstream-gone recorded, 20 closure addition(s).

Presence-only (dynamic) documents: shell.html and shell-index.html are rendered per request — consecutive GETs return 37,131 / 36,845 / 36,805 B variants (the game iframe with a freshly signed mb_rec token, or no iframe). closure.note: The closure re-scan (PLAN §4) found the refresh's additions in three passes: (1) static path literals in the freshly fetched HTML/JS/CSS plus every bare filename in the captured JSON asset manifests; (2) constructed runtime paths — the garage loads `dir + "turntable.webp"` for every car and mission and only the `assets/<dir>/` literal is in the bundle, which the 2026-10-30 offline boot exposed as two local 404s (roadster, missions); (3) the served `.gz` twin of every `.bin` literal (assets/real/yards.bin.gz). 404s are genuine upstream absences (legacy audio names in audio.json, un-gzipped dist twins) — recorded, never invented.
